sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球供应链制造母港、跨境电商货源地与外资合规准入市场

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Proprietary Ultra-Low Latency Algorithmic Market Making

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Taiwan (TW) - investor jurisdiction for the Mainland China WFOE
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA) between ARATS and SEF
Cross-Strait Agreement on Investment Protection and Promotion (IPPA), 2012
Cross-Strait Agreement on Avoidance of Double Taxation and Enhancement of Tax Cooperation, 2015

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: PRC Anti-Money Laundering Law (as amended 2020); PBOC Administrative Measures for Customer Due Diligence and Identification of Clients and Keeping Transaction Records; PBOC/SAMR Measures for Administration of Beneficial Owner Information (Order No. 3, effective 1 November 2024); SAMR Regulations on Market Entity Registration; Taiwan Money Laundering Control Act for origin-jurisdiction screening; PRC Anti-Foreign Sanctions Law; PRC Export Control Law.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Taiwanese investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) Commercial Affairs Department
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan notary public certification -> Taiwan district court notarization -> SEF verification -> ARATS verification; Taiwan is not a Hague Apostille Contracting State and there is no PRC consular post in Taiwan, so the cross-strait notarization and verification chain is the mandatory consular-equivalent legalization route.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Company Registration Record of the Taiwanese investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) Commercial Affairs Department
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan notary public certification -> Taiwan district court notarization -> SEF verification -> ARATS verification; no Hague Apostille may be attached because Taiwan is not a member of the Apostille Convention.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution or Power of Attorney authorizing WFOE formation and execution of incorporation documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the Taiwanese investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Resolution or Power of Attorney executed in Taiwan, notarized by a Taiwan notary, certified by the local district court, and then verified by SEF and ARATS; for any copy issued in a Hague member state, use a sole apostille and do not chain with consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Articles of Incorporation of the Taiwanese investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) registered company records
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Extract certified by Taiwan MOEA, notarized, and verified through SEF/ARATS; if the same document is issued in a Hague member state, a sole apostille is sufficient and no consular legalization may be added.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter from the Taiwanese investor's bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank officer signature notarized by a Taiwan notary, certified by the district court, and verified by SEF/ARATS; bank letters issued in Hague member states carry an apostille from that state only, never both apostille and consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copies of passports or corporate identity documents of all natural-person UBOs and authorized signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan notary public or identity-issuing authority in the jurisdiction of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: For Taiwan issuers, use cross-strait notarization and SEF/ARATS verification; for non-Taiwan issuers in Hague member states, apply a sole apostille; for issuers in non-member states, apply consular legalization at the PRC embassy or consulate; the two authentication regimes are parallel and mutually exclusive.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before any entity is formed, every UBO, director, shareholder, and authorized signatory shall undergo continuous screening against PRC AML/CFT criteria, PBOC/TFAC lists, SAMR blacklists, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions, OFAC SDN and non-SDN sanctions lists, EU and UK consolidated sanctions, and Taiwan competent authority alerts. Beneficial owners that are politically exposed persons require enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth documentation, and senior management approval. The compliance center must also check cross-border clearing-related sanctions, export-control restricted lists, and China's Unreliable Entity List; automated filtering must be repeated within 48 hours before signing and on the filing date of incorporation documents, with all hits escalated to the AML compliance officer.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) National Enterprise Name Self-Declaration and Registration Platform
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: A WFOE statutory name must be composed in simplified Chinese characters and follow the four-tier sequence: administrative division + distinctive trade name + industry or business characteristic + company type. The Chinese trade name may be a phonetic transliteration of the Taiwanese investor's corporate name, and the foreign full name may be shown in parentheses after the Chinese name on the business license; pinyin transliteration is accepted but local SAMR discretion controls. Latin or English words may not lead the name unless lawfully approved for an established foreign brand.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the SAMR name self-declaration is rejected, the applicant must log into the SAMR portal to download the written adverse-reason decision. If the defect is a naming conflict or prohibited token, the lawful remedy is to file a written administrative review application with the same registration authority within 15 days from the rejection notice, attaching the revised name and legalization-covered authorization. If the initial review is unsuccessful, appeal to the superior SAMR within 30 days of the first review outcome. If administrative appeal is exhausted or the authority fails to reply, bring administrative reconsider

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan Company Act (consolidated, as amended): Articles 18 (company name), 128 (incorporators), 129 (mandatory articles), 154 (limited liability), 156 (share capital), 172 (shareholder meeting), 192 and 193 (board of directors and duties), 203 (first board meeting), 208 (chairman), 218 (statutory auditor), 274 (share issuance), and 387 (registration); Foreign Investment Act Articles 7, 8, 10 and 12; Securities and Exchange Act Articles 44 and 45 for proprietary trading license.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (Taiwan); local execution through the Taipei City Government Department of Economic Development.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Registration Application accompanied by Articles of Incorporation, Director Consent Letters, and Sole Shareholder Resolution.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None under the Taiwan Company Act for a WFOE limited company; however, the Financial Supervisory Commission imposes a prudential paid-in capital expectation of at least TWD 20,000,000 (approximately USD 645,000) for a securities proprietary trading entity. The capital must be remitted into a Taiwan bank after the MOEA Investment Commission foreign investment approval is granted, evidenced by a bank capital verification certificate, and the inward remittance must be cleared by the Central Bank of Taiwan. The amount is not a blocked escrow account under the Company Act, but it remains conditionally restricted by the foreign investment remittance approval and cannot be repatriated or distributed until the FSC license is obtained and tax no-objection clearance is issued.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS RESOLUTION OF [FULL NAME OF COMPANY], AN UNLISTED LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY ORGANIZED UNDER THE LAWS OF TAIWAN.

The undersigned first board of directors of [FULL NAME OF COMPANY] (the Company), acting pursuant to Articles 192, 203 and 208 of the Taiwan Company Act, and in accordance with the Articles of Incorporation and the resolutions of the sole shareholder dated [DATE], hereby adopts the following resolutions on [DATE]:

1. Registered Office Adoption. The board adopts the Company registered office at [ADDRESS], Taipei, Taiwan, as the statutory address, principal executive office and legal seat of the Company, and directs management to file the registered address with the Ministry of Economic Affairs and to maintain the statutory registers and records at that location.

2. Share Capital Subscription and Issuance. The board approves the subscription and issuance of [NUMBER] ordinary shares with par value of TWD [X] per share, for aggregate consideration of TWD [Y], to be paid in cash within thirty days from the date of this resolution. The board approves the opening of a share register and directs the general manager to issue share certificates under the corporate seal after receipt of the full paid-in amount.

3. Banking Authority. The board authorizes the opening of corporate foreign-currency and New Taiwan Dollar accounts at [BANK NAME], designates [PERSON A] and [PERSON B] as account signatories with two-to-sign authority, and authorizes the chairman and the corporate secretary to execute and submit all banking forms, account mandates and certified extracts required by the bank.

4. Statutory Officer Appointments. The board appoints [PERSON A] as Chairman and Director, [PERSON B] as General Manager, [PERSON C] as Chief Financial Officer, and [PERSON D] as Internal Compliance Officer. The board appoints [ACCOUNTING FIRM] as the independent auditor for the first fiscal year and directs the officers to file the required appointment notices with the competent registry.

5. Regulatory Authorization. The board authorizes the General Manager and the Compliance Officer to prepare, execute and submit all filings required by the Taiwan Company Act and the Financial Supervisory Commission for the proprietary algorithmic high-frequency trading license, including the securities firm license application, internal control documents, market-making algorithm governance policies, cybersecurity statements, business continuity plans, and anti-money-laundering and counter-financing-of-terrorism compliance declarations.

6. General Ratification and Direction. All actions taken by the incorporators, officers and attorneys-in-fact prior to the date of this resolution in furtherance of the incorporation of the Company are ratified, confirmed and approved. Each officer and director is authorized and directed to execute, notarize, deliver and file any instrument, certificate, notice or application necessary to make these resolutions fully effective. This resolution is effective immediately upon adoption and may be certified by the Chairman, the Company Secretary or any director.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Incorporation Name Reservation and Foreign Investment Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) One-Stop Name Pre-Screening Portal; MOEA Investment Commission, Foreign Investor Approval Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed English and Chinese legal names with a non-conflicting bilingual business scope to the MOEA name reservation portal. Concurrently file a Foreign Investment Application through the Investment Commission online system. The filing must identify the ultimate beneficial owner of the Chinese parent company, describe the proprietary ultra-low-latency algorithmic market-making model, provide proof of funds or audited financial statements, and certify that no restricted intellectual property transfer is involved. The Investment Commission screens for national security, prohibited industries and public interest. Once approved, the foreign investor receives an Approval Letter valid for 180 days, and the name reservation is similarly reserved for 180 days. Only after both clearances may the applicant proceed to corporate document filing.
required_dossiers: Foreign Investment Application form
Ultimate beneficial owner affidavit and passport copies
Proof of funds or audited financial statements of the foreign parent
Business plan describing algorithmic market-making and risk management
Power of attorney in favor of the local agent
Proposed Articles of Incorporation in English and Chinese
Name reservation receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MOEA issues a formal query, file a supplementary explanation within 14 days; if the application is suspended because of a name conflict, reserve a new name and refile; a denial of foreign investment approval may be appealed to the MOEA Appeal Committee under the Administrative Appeal Act within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution, Notarization and Filing of Company Incorporation Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Department of Commerce; local filing window: Taipei City Government Department of Economic Development
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The incorporator or local agent signs the Articles of Incorporation, director consent letters, shareholder resolutions and corporate seal forms. Documents executed outside Taiwan must be notarized or apostilled in the country of execution, then translated into Chinese and English, and authenticated by a Taiwan notary public if required. File the incorporation application with the MOEA company registration system using the applicant's electronic certificate. The filing must include the registered office address, directors, corporate seal, business scope and foreign investment approval letter. Upon review and payment of the registration fee, MOEA issues the Company Registration Certificate and a Uniform Company Number. The statutory review period is approximately seven working days.
required_dossiers: Duly executed Articles of Incorporation
Written consent of each director to act
Sole shareholder written resolution
Power of attorney and identity document of the local agent
MOEA Investment Commission foreign investment approval letter
Proof of registered office address: lease agreement and landlord consent
Corporate seal registration form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a defect notice, cure the defects within 15 days by filing amended pages through the same portal; if a director refuses to serve, appoint a replacement by shareholder resolution and file an amended director consent; a denial may be administratively appealed within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Remittance, Bank Account Opening and Capital Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A Taiwan foreign exchange bank designated by the applicant; Central Bank of Taiwan for foreign exchange reporting
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the foreign investment approval, open a New Taiwan Dollar demand deposit account and a segregated capital account at a licensed bank in Taipei in the name of the Company. The sole foreign shareholder must remit the approved capital amount from abroad by telegraphic transfer using the direct investment transaction code. The receiving bank files the inward remittance report with the Central Bank of Taiwan. Withdrawals are not permitted until the bank issues the capital verification certificate and the MOEA Investment Commission records final capital use approval. The board then allocates the shares and confirms payment. The same bank account will later be used for market-making settlement and clearing. The entire capital remittance process must be completed within the validity period of the foreign investment approval.
required_dossiers: MOEA Investment Commission approval letter
Company Registration Certificate
Board resolution opening bank accounts and designating signatories
Passport copies of authorized signatories
Corporate seal and company registration extract
Inward remittance instruction with source of funds declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank declines the account, present the MOEA approval letter and Company Registration Certificate; an AML-based refusal may be cured by submitting enhanced source-of-wealth documentation or choosing a second licensed bank; if the Central Bank of Taiwan flags the remittance, respond through the bank to the related-party explanation questionnaire within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, Financial License Application and FSC Authorization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau under the Ministry of Finance; Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC), Securities and Futures Bureau
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register with the local National Taxation Bureau for profit-seeking enterprise income tax, business tax, uniform invoices and withholding tax; the tax authority will issue the taxpayer identification certificate. Then file the FSC application for a proprietary trading securities firm license covering algorithmic high-frequency trading. The application must include the organisational structure, internal controls, risk management policy, market-making algorithm governance, latency monitoring, information security standards, business continuity plan and AML/CFT policies. No live trading may occur before the FSC license is issued. The FSC may require a supervised test period, independent audit of algorithm controls and exchange connectivity approval.
required_dossiers: Tax registration application
Business scope and financial projections
FSC license application form
Internal control and AML/CFT manuals
Algorithm risk disclosure and governance statement
Capital verification certificate and bank statements
Audited financial statements or capital evidence
Fit-and-proper statements for officers and substantial shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the FSC requests additional information, respond within the specified deadline, generally 30 days; if the license is denied, request a written reason and file an administrative appeal with the Executive Yuan within 30 days; for tax registration errors, file corrected returns and amendments before the FSC decision.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance, Corporate Seal, Work Rules and Exchange Connectivity
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taipei City Government Department of Labor Affairs; Taiwan Stock Exchange Corporation and Taipei Exchange for market maker admission; company external counsel and corporate secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registration and licensing, hold the organisational board meeting to adopt bank signatory cards, issue share certificates, elect the statutory auditor if required, adopt work rules and employee handbook, and approve the corporate seal. Register work rules with the Taipei City Government Department of Labor Affairs. For trading operations, execute exchange connectivity agreements, co-location or hosting agreements and market-maker arrangements. File final board minutes and officer and auditor appointments with the MOEA registry. Maintain all statutory books at the registered office. This final step transitions the entity from formation to licensed operational status.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the organisational board meeting
Share certificates issued to shareholders
Corporate seal registration form
Work rules registration form
Exchange market maker application
Officer and auditor appointment forms
Lease agreements for office and data center or co-location
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the work-rules filing is rejected, amend non-statutory provisions and resubmit; if exchange connectivity is delayed, coordinate through FSC and the exchange compliance team; a failure to appoint required officers may be cured by board resolution and an MOEA amendment filing within 15 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC), Securities and Futures Bureau, Taiwan, with exchange-level regulation by the Taiwan Stock Exchange Corporation and Taipei Exchange for market-making operations.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Proprietary Trading Securities Firm License under Article 44 of the Securities and Exchange Act, together with FSC approval for algorithmic ultra-low-latency trading and, if applicable, Registered Market Maker status with the relevant exchange.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Not Applicable - no physical manufacturing, chemical, assembly or warehousing assets are covered by ISIC 6499; the only environmental interface is the office and data-center co-location, which is subject to the Taipei City Government Department of Environmental Protection.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not Applicable - no EIA or Environmental Registration is required because the entity is a financial services trader with no stationary emission source.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable - no industrial wastewater, VOC or hazardous-waste thresholds apply to this scope. Office and server operations must nevertheless comply with Taipei City indoor air quality rules and general e-waste collection obligations where waste is generated.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable for civil-defense industrial permits; however, the Company must obtain a fire-safety inspection certificate from the Taipei City Fire Department for the registered office and co-location space, a valid building occupancy and structural load certificate from a licensed engineer for rack installations, and occupational safety and health compliance under the Taiwan Occupational Safety and Health Act for all employees.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance, National Taxation Bureau (regional National Taxation Bureaus) is the registration and collection authority; electronic portals: MOF Tax Portal at tax.nat.gov.tw and MOF Electronic Invoice Integration Platform at e-invoice.nat.gov.tw
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Establish Taiwan tax nexus: fixed place of business, dependent agent concluding contracts, or taxable sales of goods/services in Taiwan. 2) Appoint a Taiwan resident tax/accounting agent and, for the WFOE/branch form, register the legal presence with the Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA). 3) Compile the notarised parent incorporation certificate, constitutional documents, board resolution appointing the local managing officer, identity credentials, Taiwan fixed-place address proof, Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) licence for algorithmic market-making, and AML/KYC compliance evidence. 4) File the tax registration application (Application for Tax Registration / Unified Business Number) with the governing National Taxation Bureau via the MOF Tax Portal or in person; a foreign digital-service supplier without a fixed place may use the dedicated foreign e-commerce VAT registration module. 5) On approval the authority issues the eight-digit Unified Business Number (TIN), which functions as both the Business Tax (VAT) identifier and the profit-seeking enterprise income-tax registration number. 6) Complete Uniform Invoice registration and apply for the e-invoice digital certificate and Turnkey transmission account. 7) For pure offshore electronic services to Taiwan individuals, registration is required only if annual taxable sales exceed NT$480,000. 8) Keep the TIN registration file current and file monthly/quarterly indirect tax returns according to the assigned filing cycle.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None (Taiwan does not operate a U.S.-style check-the-box election or hybrid mismatch election). Procedural options only: a small-scale business operator may elect to become a general VAT taxpayer to claim input credits, and a foreign electronic-service supplier may elect the simplified VAT registration route; neither election alters entity classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (Business Tax) under the Value-Added and Non-Value-Added Business Tax Act; standard VAT with a special non-value-added business tax regime for licensed financial/securities enterprises
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary threshold for resident/in-residence businesses: registration is mandatory before commencing any taxable sale in Taiwan. Small-scale operators with average monthly sales below NT$80,000 for goods or NT$40,000 for services use a simplified quarterly assessment and do not issue Uniform Invoices; foreign suppliers of electronic services to Taiwan individuals must register when annual sales exceed NT$480,000. A licensed financial/securities entity may instead fall under the 2% non-value-added business tax on gross revenue under Article 11 of the Business Tax Act.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Taiwan operates a mandatory Uniform Invoice regime rather than a continuous real-time fiscal pre-clearance system. Standard VAT taxpayers must transmit invoice data through the MOF Electronic Invoice Integration Platform (e-invoice.nat.gov.tw) using the e-invoice Turnkey API and a MOF digital certificate; each e-invoice carries a unique invoice number and random anti-fraud code validated on the platform. B2C e-invoices are stored in the cloud with the MOF verification seal; paper Uniform Invoices are likewise reported through the same information pipeline. Small-scale businesses are exempt from issuing Uniform Invoices but must submit prescribed purchased/sales reports. Failed transmissions, stale invoices, or non-matching TINs expose the taxpayer to rejection and penalty risk.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies under Article 7 of the Business Tax Act to goods physically exported from Taiwan and to services supplied to foreign enterprises or individuals where the services are used outside Taiwan or are incidental to exported goods; international transport and certain offshore services also qualify. For algorithmic market-making, export zero-rating can be claimed only if the services are sold to a foreign counterparty and are not treated as used in Taiwan; purely proprietary trading on the WFOE's own account is not an exported service and creates no zero-rated output VAT. Excess input VAT attributable to zero-rated exports may be refunded under the VAT refund provisions rather than carried forward.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration filed through the Customs Administration of the Ministry of Finance
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill or carrier/forwarder cargo receipt evidencing physical departure from Taiwan
Commercial invoice and packing list matching the Customs Export Declaration
Export sales contract, purchase order or market-making service agreement with the foreign counterparty
Foreign exchange receipt / inward remittance certificate issued by an authorised bank evidencing receipt of export proceeds
Service completion or delivery records demonstrating that the service was performed outside Taiwan for zero-rated exported services
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The National Taxation Bureau will compare the Customs Export Declaration, transport documents, contract terms and bank remittance records. If any statutory document is missing, inconsistent or non-contemporaneous, the zero-rating is disallowed and the exporter is assessed 5% output VAT on the transaction with interest. Intentional falsification of customs or foreign-exchange documents triggers Article 41 criminal liability for tax evasion under the Business Tax Act, Article 51 administrative fines of up to five times the evaded tax, possible business suspension, and retroactive clawback of any refunded VAT within the statutory collection period (7 years for fraud/non-filing cases). Failure to repatriate export proceeds within the 180-day deadline, absent an approved extension from the central bank, may also cause the zero-rating to be revoked.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates a managed floating exchange rate regime under PBOC oversight. Capital account transactions remain strictly controlled and require prior SAFE approval for inflows, outflows, equity investments, and most cross-border capital movements. Current account transactions are generally convertible, enabling profit remittances, dividends, and trade settlements subject to corporate income tax clearance and supporting documentation. Profit repatriation faces no material convertibility hurdles once tax obligations are met.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Mandatory surrender of 30% of foreign exchange export proceeds to the bank within five working days for eligible trade transactions, with possible extensions upon justification. Proprietary algorithmic trading activities fall outside surrender obligations unless reclassified as export-related.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low viability; Chinese regulations prohibit unlicensed offshore electronic money institutions for domestic entities. Cross-border EMIs require SAFE filings and domestic licensed channels with full AML/KYC compliance.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of directors and authorized signatories is mandatory for KYC interviews and account opening at tier-1 commercial banks; remote opening is not permitted for WFOEs.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity or inconsistent source of funds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of incorporation, verified shareholding register, director passports, source-of-funds letters, and audited financial statements

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital routed via SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'CAP' or 'EQUITY'. Requires prior SAFE approval for capital account transactions. Verification includes KYC, source-of-funds evidence, and legal opinions.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements cleared via SWIFT MT103 or Commercial Letters of Credit. For algorithmic trading liquidity, interbank FX markets accessed through correspondent banking relationships.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Shareholders' Meeting (股東常會) and meeting minutes distribution
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders in general meeting; minutes retained in the Minute Book at the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Held within 6 months after fiscal-year end (by June 30 for a calendar-year company); minutes distributed within 15 days after the meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene the meeting allows the MOEA to impose fines on the responsible officer (NT$10,000–NT$100,000 range) and to issue remedial orders; continued non-compliance supports administrative dissolution under Company Act Article 10 for companies with suspended operations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements filing to the competent authority (財務報表備查) after shareholders' approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Commercial Development Administration (經濟部商業發展署)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 days after shareholders' approval at the annual general meeting; i.e., no later than July 15 for a calendar-year company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: MOEA may issue a corrective order and impose administrative fines of NT$10,000–NT$50,000 per violation; repeated refusal to file may trigger escalated fines and, in egregious cases, administrative proceedings under the Company Act that can culminate in deregistration / administrative dissolution

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax annual settlement return (營利事業所得稅結算申報)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Administration, local district tax bureau (財政部各地區國稅局)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: May 31 of the year following the calendar tax year; extension may be applied under MOF rules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing after official demand attracts a 10% delinquency fee of the assessed tax (minimum NT$1,500); late payment incurs a 1% surcharge per two days up to 15%; willful non-filing empowers the tax authority to assess on information obtained and initiate coercive collection

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation and, if changed, updated filing of directors, managers, supervisors, and beneficial owners (受益所有人申報)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Company Registration One-Stop Portal (公司申報系統)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual internal confirmation by March 31 following the reporting year; any change must be filed within 15 days of the triggering event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or correct within the MOEA notice period attracts fines of NT$50,000–NT$500,000 with per-instance repeat penalties; persistent default may result in publication of default and compulsory correction

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory CPA audit where paid-in capital exceeds NT$30 million (approx. USD 1 million), for all financial institutions and public companies, or where otherwise required by the MOEA; below the threshold, unaudited financial statements are admissible provided they are prepared under statutory accounting standards
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Taiwan Business Entity Accounting Act (商業會計法); private companies apply Enterprise Accounting Standards (EAS / 企業會計準則公報), while publicly listed companies apply IFRS as endorsed by the FSC; voluntary IFRS election is permitted for private companies with consistency requirement

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Company Act Article 22-1, the company must report directors, managers, supervisors, and shareholders holding more than 10% of shares to the MOEA within 15 days of incorporation and within 15 days of any change; an annual internal confirmation of the beneficial ownership register is performed in the first calendar quarter (by March 31) to trigger any necessary update filing and to align the on-site register with the MOEA electronic registry
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors and Supervisors (董監事名冊)
Minute Book (股東會議事錄及董事會議事錄)
Register of Beneficial Owners / Shareholding over 10% Declaration

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (PRC Enterprise Income Tax Law Art. 4; statutory resident rate)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Preferential effective rates available to a qualifying WFOE: (i) 15% High-New Technology Enterprise (HNTE) rate for certified algorithmic/software trading firms with qualifying IP and R&D intensity; (ii) 10% 'Key Software Enterprise' rate where separately certified; (iii) small low-profit enterprise (小微企业) effective preference: 25% rate on taxable income above RMB 3M with incremental relief resulting in approximately 5% effective rate on the first RMB 3M (annual taxable income cap RMB 3M, ≤300 employees, ≤RMB 50M assets); (iv) 15% Western Development Zone or free-trade-zone preferential policies where location requirement met. Statutory 'two-year exemption, three-year half rate' tax holidays for newly established integrated circuit and software enterprises are available only to qualifying semiconductor/software industrial enterprises, not to pure proprietary HFT market-making activities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: 中华人民共和国企业所得税月（季）度预缴纳税申报表（A类，2021年版）; filed electronically via the Provincial Electronic Tax Bureau (电子税务局) / e-Tax system (e-Tax@China), login with Unified Social Credit Code and digital certificate (CA).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Quarterly (within 15 days after the end of each quarter); taxpayers with small profits may elect semi-annual payment upon approval.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 15 calendar days following the close of each quarter (PRC EIT Law Art. 54); i.e., Q1 by Apr 15, Q2 by Jul 15, Q3 by Oct 15, Q4 settled in the annual return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: 表头基础信息 (A200000 基础信息栏)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification number (统一社会信用代码), name, industry code (ISIC 6499 / GB/T 4754 industry code mapping to '金融业' or '软件和信息技术服务业' as registered), taxpayer type, accounting standards flag.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: WFOE is a PRC resident enterprise; enter the Chinese tax ID, mark 外商独资企业 ownership, and include Taiwan investor percentage in the equity-ownership appendix.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate revenue from HFT market-making, proprietary trading gains, software/Algo licensing and clearing-related service income per accrual-basis financial statements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile with SAFE cross-border payment records and audited FS; cross-border revenue from non-resident counterparties is NOT separately split for the quarterly form.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs: colocation hosting fees, exchange membership fees, data-feed licensing, compensation of quantitative developers and trading infrastructure costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If algorithm/data-feed fees are paid to Taiwan affiliated suppliers, classify as related-party cost items and disclose in the related-party transaction disclosure forms.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net accounting profit before income tax derived from the income statement of the quarter, cumulative year-to-date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Adjust for any permanent differences arising from treaty election only in the annual return; do not net withholding taxes on outbound remittances against quarterly profit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 4 实际利润额 (Actual Taxable Profit)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable profit computed by adding back accounting-tax differences; equals total profit less current-period tax exempt/deductible items for quarterly prepayment purposes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply standard adjustments for items on Schedule A105000 (纳税调整项目明细表) only where previously logged in the quarterly computation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enter 25% statutory rate or 15% if HNTE certification valid; attach certificate number (证书编号) in the e-filing annex.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Taiwanese-invested WFOE holding HNTE certificate may assert 15%; do not apply a Taiwan-specific rate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 6 应纳所得税额 (Tax Payable at Book Tax Basis)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Line 5 × Line 4, reflecting the cumulative prepayment tax liability.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Subsequent lines offset already withheld domestic taxes and prior prepayments; no foreign tax credits for Taiwan-source income in the quarterly form.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 7 减免所得税额 (Tax Reduction)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Preferential reductions such as the small low-profit enterprise incremental relief or software enterprise rate cut; computed on Schedule A201030.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify ineligible where the WFOE fails employee headcount or asset thresholds due to pure proprietary trading structure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 8 本期应补（退）所得税额 (Current Period Tax Due/Refund)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cumulative tax payable less cumulative prepaid instalments; this is the treasury remittance or credit brought forward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Settlement between foreign-exchange payments and tax treasury account must leave no cross-currency mismatch.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: Tax Collection Law (税收征收管理法) Art. 62 — written correction order plus RMB 2,000 fine (up to RMB 10,000 for serious cases) per return. Late payment: Art. 32 — daily surcharge of 0.05% (万分之五) on the overdue tax amount from the statutory deadline until payment. Intentional non-filing triggering tax evasion assessment exposes 50% to 5× penalty plus criminal referral under Criminal Law Art. 201.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: 中华人民共和国企业所得税年度纳税申报表（A类，2017年版及后续修订，2021版）; electronic filing through the Electronic Tax Bureau (电子税务局) with the full 37-form annual package including 主表 A100000, Schedule A105000 (纳税调整项目明细表), Schedule A107014 (协定待遇), and the related-party transaction annual report forms (关联业务往来年度报告表).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (one final settlement per fiscal year-ending December 31 unless a special accounting year is approved by the tax authority).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 5 months after the close of the tax year — i.e., by May 31 for a calendar-year WFOE (EIT Law Art. 54). Independent audit report and related-party filing (G20-form package) submitted contemporaneously.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form A000000 企业基础信息表
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, unified social credit code, registered capital, shareholder composition (Taiwan investor equity %), industry classification code, HNTE certificate status, presence of offshore branches.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Indicate the Taiwan shareholder’s country code TW, beneficial-ownership percentages, and any intermediate Hong Kong/Singapore holding companies to enable the potential 5% DTA analysis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total audited revenue including realised trading gains/losses, market-making spread income, exchange rebates, and Algo-as-a-Service license fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Revenue from foreign exchanges / Fedwire clearing is included as PRC-source if the WFOE books it in China; apply sourcing rules if the exchange is offshore.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Audited accounting profit before income tax; must agree to the audited income statement and unqualified audit opinion.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the Taiwan parent performs any back-office functions, ensure service fees invoiced to the WFOE are arm's length and supported by contracts, time sheets and actual discharges.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: A105000 纳税调整项目明细表 (Line 15-16 adjustments)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Adjustments for non-deductible entertainment expenses (60% deductible, capped at 0.5% of revenue), advertisement costs, related-party interest thin capitalization (2:1 debt-to-equity cap; 5:1 for financial firms if qualified), and accrual-to-cash differences.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Trading losses on low-liquidity algorithmically opened positions are generally deductible only upon disposal; document valuation marks to support adjustments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: A100000 Line 17 免税、减计收入及加计扣除 (Lines 18-20 related)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempt treasury-bond interest, 100% additional R&D expense deduction (按100%加计扣除) for qualifying software R&D, and 10% deduction for booking domestic software costs; plus 50% additional deduction for high-tech R&D if not HNTE-certified in certain zones.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: R&D credits apply only where software/algo development occurs in PRC with qualified personnel; offshore development by Taiwan coders generally excluded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: A100000 Line 18-19 应纳税所得额 and 税率
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after all adjustments; multiplied by 25% statutory rate or certified preferential 15% HNTE rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses carried forward up to 5 years (10 years for qualified HNTE/tech SMEs) offset before any dividend-sharing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: A100000 Line 25 实际应纳所得税额 and Schedule A109000 境外所得抵免
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final tax due after domestic preferential reductions; foreign income tax credits available for Taiwan-source branch income computed separately.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE must not credit Taiwan withholding on dividends paid to the parent against PRC CIT; these are shareholder-level taxes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: A107010/A107012 免税、减计收入与研发加计扣除表
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Attach full engineering R&D project documentation, expense ledger, and R&D personnel roster for the 100% super-deduction.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Retain China working-vesting agreements, patents/实用新型 registration certificates and payroll proof to survive a challenge that R&D was performed offshore.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: 关联业务往来年度报告表 (G-forms G100000-G122000)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Integrated related-party transaction disclosure: balances, revenue, cost, intangibles, interest and services flows with Taiwan parent, including positions into clearing houses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose all algorithm data-feed purchases from Taiwan affiliates and state that transfer-pricing documentation (local file/master file) thresholds have been assessed and satisfied/waived.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Annual return not filed by May 31: EIT Law Art. 49 and Tax Collection Law Art. 62 — late filing fine RMB 2,000 (RMB 10,000 serious) plus 0.05% daily late-payment surcharge on the unpaid balance. Understatement from false filings triggers 50% to 5× penalty; egregious falsification of books may trigger criminal referral for 逃税罪 with imprisonment up to 7 years.
